title: The amalgamation stage names the common part instead of the other target.
details: In the sufficiency proof of Theorem6.6, printed p.62, the task is an embedding g:C→A_i and the current chain supplies f:C→B_{n−1}. The sentence instructs one to embed B_{n−1} and C into the new stage. The objects to amalgamate are B_{n−1} and A_i, over the common domain C; the adjacent diagram correctly displays A_i. The corpus writes the actual two embeddings and the required equality u∘f=v∘g. This is a local name slip; the construction is repaired without changing the theorem.
